shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references; cat AGENTS.md | head -30; ls src 2>/dev/null
rg -n -i -C 4 "dashboard|дашборд|grid" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; ls __agent_eval__; git status --short
npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20

npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit@10.5.2 @gravity-ui/icons 2>&1 | tail -8; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/dist/docs 2>&1 | head -30

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/*; grep -n '"version"\|"@gravity-ui' package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head
sed -n 150,520p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -200; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | grep -n -A30 '"exports"\|"main"\|"style"' | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -40 | grep -n -i "css\|style"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && ls; find . -name "*.css" -o -name "*.scss" | head -5; cat index.d.ts; cat components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; grep -rn "PluginDefaultLayout\|interface Plugin\b\|PluginBase" --include=*.d.ts . | head; cd ../..; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/shared/types/config.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && cat typings/plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; cat shared/types/plugin.d.ts | head -60; cat shared/types/config.d.ts | head -60; ls components; grep -n "ActionPanel" -r components/index.d.ts components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.d.ts | head; grep -rn "styles" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head

cat components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; grep -n "SetConfigItem\|interface Settings\|SettingsProps\|MenuItem\b" -A14 typings/common.d.ts | head -90; grep -n "ItemDropProps" -A8 shared/types/*.d.ts | head -20; cat components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "OverlayControlItem" -A12 components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts | head -30

grep -rn "SetConfigItem\b" -B1 -A12 typings/*.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "MenuItems" -A8 constants/*.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "OverlayCustomControlItem" -A8 typings/common.d.ts | head -20; cat shared/types/common.d.ts | sed -n 1,18p; ls plugins; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | head -3; grep -rn "export.*configure" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts

sed -n 1,9p typings/config.d.ts; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm i @gravity-ui/charts 2>&1 | tail -3; grep '"version"\|peerDep' -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>&1
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm i @gravity-ui/charts 2>&1 | grep -i "peer\|Found\|Could not" | head -6; git status --short; grep -n dependencies -A8 package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && for n in ChartColumn ChartLine Pencil Check Plus ListCheck Cubes Gear Persons CircleInfo ArrowUp ArrowDown TextAlignLeft Heading Xmark ArrowRotateLeft; do ls ChartColumn.js >/dev/null 2>&1; [ -f "$n.js" ] && echo "OK $n" || echo "-- $n"; done; ls | head -3; grep -n "Progress\b" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "theme\|size\|value\|text" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,30p /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls icons/TrashBin.js icons/Copy.js icons/LayoutCellsLarge.js icons/Hashtag.js icons/Clock.js 2>&1; grep -n "OverlayCustomControlItem" -B2 -A8 dashkit/build/esm/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "DashKit\b.*overlayMenuItems\|delete" dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && grep -rn "MenuItems.Delete" --include=*.js . | head; grep -n "Delete" -B3 -A12 components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js | sed -n 1,60p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF' p='src/App.tsx' s=open(p).read() a=s.index(" {editMode ? (\n ") b=s.index(" \n );\n}") new='''
{dashboard} {editMode && }
''' s=s[:a]+new+s[b:] open(p,'w').write(s) EOF npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8; rm -rf dist; grep -n "size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/*.d.ts | head -5; git status --short
grep -rn "PluginTitleSize =" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/*.d.ts
